data.label: Synthetic services (log/trace emitters)
data.description: Synthetic workloads emitting structured logs and OpenTelemetry traces. Outside provisioning scope.

data.label: Telemetry collection
data.description: Receives logs and traces; a log sink routes entries plus trace IDs to Pub/Sub for redaction.
data.service: Cloud Logging + Cloud Trace (log sink to Pub/Sub)

data.label: Redaction worker
data.description: De-identifies secrets/PII before storage; keeps original record IDs for evidence. Raw unredacted text is not persisted beyond short retention.
data.service: Cloud Run job + Sensitive Data Protection

data.label: Telemetry store & search
data.description: Holds redacted logs and spans joined by trace_id; time-window and service queries feed analysis.
data.service: BigQuery (redacted logs + spans, partitioned by time)

data.label: Incident analysis runtime
data.description: Queries correlated evidence, wraps log text as untrusted quoted data, calls the model, validates that every claim cites log/span IDs, abstains when evidence is insufficient. Returns the cited explanation to the operator.
data.service: Cloud Run service (service account, read-only BigQuery)

data.label: LLM
data.description: Generates the explanation from supplied evidence only. Regional availability and quota unverified.
data.service: Vertex AI Gemini (model ID to be selected)

data.label: On-call operator
data.description: Asks about an incident and receives an explanation with source log/trace evidence. Authenticated via IAP (to be confirmed).

brief.application: Use Google Cloud for this synthetic architecture qualification. Correlate synthetic logs and distributed traces to explain a service incident. Include collection, redaction, storage/search, an AI analysis runtime and an operator-facing answer with source evidence. Treat log text as untrusted. Draw the complete end-to-end architecture with concrete service choices and connected flows. Explain the first local test, distinguish mocked model behavior from actual model validation, and ask one useful missing-decision question. Do not reduce this application to storage to satisfy generator coverage. Do not invent successful deployment or approved region/account access.

lastAsked.question: Where do the files live, and roughly how many are there?
lastAsked.beginner: For example “SharePoint and a shared drive, about 20,000 files”.

requirements.statement: Proposed: the analysis runtime treats log and trace text as untrusted data; instructions embedded in it must not change model behaviour or trigger actions.
requirements.rationale: Prompt injection via log lines could produce misleading incident explanations.

requirements.statement: Proposed: sensitive values are redacted before telemetry is stored or sent to the model.
requirements.rationale: Prevents secrets/PII leaking into search and model prompts.

requirements.statement: Proposed: every explanation cites the log entry and span IDs it relies on, or abstains if evidence is insufficient.
requirements.rationale: Operators must verify conclusions; uncited claims risk wrong remediation.

decisions.subject: design.google-cloud-incident-correlation-logs-traces-to-cited-ai-explanation
decisions.title: Google Cloud incident correlation: logs + traces to cited AI explanation
decisions.context: Scope: synthetic logs/traces collected, redacted, stored/searchable, analysed by a Vertex AI-backed Cloud Run runtime, answered to an operator with source evidence. Assumptions: synthetic data only, region and project/account access not selected or approved, model ID unselected. Design-only; no native generator coverage for these GCP services, no deployment.
